Folks —

Quick ask: Cassio Labs is blocked on a regulatory data ingress assessment that pushed their pilot timeline out by ~6 weeks. They’re a strategic mid-market prospect (GenAI in clinical supply routing) and procurement is asking for two concessions to keep momentum: a 60-day extension to the sandbox window and a one-time $25k complementary credit to cover the delayed testing burst.

Why I’m asking: the delay is not our fault; the customer needs the extra runway to validate integration with a hospital partner. If we deny, they’ll pause the pilot and hand the RFP to a competitor that offered a longer no-cost window. We’ve already invested ~3 integration sprints of SE time.

Key facts:
- Related account: Cassio Labs (Sanjay Patel, Karen Li)
- Current sandbox expiry: 2028-05-10
- Requested extension: +60 days (new expiry 2028-07-09)
- Requested one-time credits: $25,000 applied to hosted usage during extended window
- Attachments: Cassio_POCTimeline.xlsx (updated timeline), Cassio_Pilot_Logistics.pdf (notes from SE)

Proposed gating if approved:
- Customer signs a short addendum (DocuSign link below) agreeing to a 90-day conversion checkpoint (metrics + decision)
- Credits expire if no conversion decision by checkpoint

I’m asking for an exception to PLG limits (standard is 30 days / $5k). Please advise — Marissa, can Deal Desk approve the one-time uplift, or do we need CRO/CEO sign-off? Aditya, any objections from finance?

Thanks,
Olga
